art_direction.identity: The shop as an old-master floral still life: flowers glowing out of a dark, varnished green-umber ground, lit from one side. Square-cornered photographs hung like paintings, hairline rules, generous dark space.
art_direction.type: Castoro (a Dutch old-style serif) for every heading, arrangement name, and numeral; its italic for Latin flower names and asides. Hanken Grotesk for body and interface text at 1rem with a relaxed line height. Prices use tabular numerals.
art_direction.color: Dark theme. Canvas and a one-step-lighter surface band, vellum ink in two tiers (ink, muted), hairline lines. One spot color: primary (peony coral) only for the order button, the numerals of the still-life key, and link hovers. Never add a second accent; the photographs carry the color.
art_direction.signature: The keyed still life — a portrait photograph of this week's arrangement beside a museum-label key that numbers each stem with its common name, italic Latin name, and the farm it came from. Keep it on the homepage and update it with the season.
art_direction.voice: Unhurried and exact about stems, growers, and delivery times. Short sentences. No exclamation points, no superlatives.
